correction: One signed global offset per outer fold: 24/(24+24) times the mean of the 24 monthly mean prediction-minus-observation errors.
application: max(0, original outer U-Net rainfall - offset); then 0.75*original hybrid + 0.25*corrected U-Net
epoch_selection: The auxiliary calibration predictor selects epochs in a separate earlier chronological split, never on the 24 calibration targets. The original outer predictor keeps its original epoch-selection procedure.
transfer_assumption: Bias estimated from an earlier, shorter-training auxiliary model is transferred to the fully refitted outer U-Net. This assumption is tested, not guaranteed.
